messages.author: 3fac1adbbccc0fc6
messages.subject: Help with WarpRefMesh
parts:
Hi all,

I've been away from a project for a few months, and now I am getting some an error in "WarpRefMesh"--i.e., Error in xyz.coords(digitspec[1:fixed,]) : 'x' , 'y' , and 'z' lengths differ.

As per the documentation I've checked to make sure the mesh and associated coordinates are in the same scale.

Does anyone have any ideas?

Thanks in advance,
Terry

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] Help with WarpRefMesh
parts:
Terry,

 

As per this blog, there was a bug-fix in that function that came about with changes to base-R.  Please reinstall from Github both RRPP and geomorph, and try again. If that does not fix the problem let us know.

 

Dean

 

devtools::install_github(‘mlcollyer/RRPP’)

devtools::install_github(‘geomorphR/geomorph’,ref=’Stable’)

 

 

Dr. Dean C. Adams

Director of Graduate Education, EEB Program
